source_refs.note: Hormonal control of kidney functions, printed as 14.1.2 (it belongs under 14.2), with its two Tidbits and the box on the two capillary beds (PDF 17-18).

blocks.text: When body needs to conserve water, kidneys excrete a hypertonic urine. When there is much water in body, kidneys excrete a hypotonic urine. These functions of kidneys are coordinated by the following hormones.
